title: PROTOTYPES.DIR
heading: Prototypes
description: Gameplay and tool experiments built to test a specific question before committing to a larger project.

children.title: VOID_OVERDRIVE.DIR
children.heading: Void Overdrive
children.description: Tested whether fast hoverbike exploration could support a slower survival game. The prototype exposed an unresolved conflict between those two experiences.
children.role: CREATIVE DIRECTION / GAME DESIGN / ART / DEVELOPMENT

children.title: PROJECT_HYPNO.DIR
children.heading: Project Hypno
children.description: A two-week horror prototype testing atmosphere, tactile interaction, and spatial anomalies before attempting a larger gameplay framework.

children.title: PROJECT_SUNSHINE.DIR
children.heading: Project Sunshine
children.description: Turned a world concept into a one-week Blender film mock-up, using one song to shape the sequence and mood.

children.title: MIGHTY_PEBBLE.DIR
children.heading: Mighty Pebble
children.description: A resource-gathering clicker prototype that led me to reconsider 3D in favor of a 2D presentation.

children.title: MATTERCRAFT.DIR
children.heading: Mattercraft
children.description: A card-based crafting prototype combining material recipes and a clicker economy, with automation as a direction for further development.

children.title: SPACEKEEPER.DIR
children.heading: Spacekeeper
children.description: A one-week space-station prototype testing gathering, survival, and a daily routine, with particular attention to interface and sound feedback.

children.title: FOX_STORIES.DIR
children.heading: Fox Stories
children.description: An atmospheric exploration prototype whose trailer reached 1.6 million views on Imgur. The response outpaced the implemented gameplay loop.

children.title: KCD_COMBAT.DIR
children.heading: Combat prototype
children.description: A combat-interaction prototype, presented as a gameplay test.

children.title: LEVEL_DESIGN.DIR
children.heading: Grand Bazaar blockout
children.description: Recreated Grand Bazaar from Battlefield 3 to study scale, sightlines, cover, and iteration in a real-time CSG blockout workflow.

children.title: MOVING_ON_EXPRESS
children.heading: Moving On Express
children.description: Designed and built a one-week moving-company game in which players load a truck quickly while avoiding damage to a family’s belongings.
